messages:
Hannah Park: starting the SDK publish window for py/ts 3.1.4. Can we please keep the final dist-tag flip gated until smoke clears?
Diego Morales: acknowledged. CI kicked off py wheel and npm jobs. Will watch the publish logs.
release-bot: [publish] job=200111 status=running step=py-build
Sara Venkataraman: quick heads-up: docs team asked for the deprecation blurb to go out with the release about the old sync client. I'll attach the short note to the changelog PR after publish.
deploy-bot: [publish] job=200111 status=failed step=ts-upload reason=403 Forbidden (rate-limited)
Hannah Park: hmm 403 rate limit on npm. Did we hit the registry quota from parallel canaries?
InfraOps: registry reported a short publish-rate throttle for the org. We can request a burst quota but that will take a few minutes. Options: (1) pause and retry after quota lift, (2) publish py wheel first and hold npm promotion, (3) re-run npm publish with exponential backoff.
Diego Morales: prefer (2) to avoid blocking PyPI consumers. We'll publish Python first, then retry npm with backoff and hold `latest` until both are green.
release-bot: [publish] job=200112 status=success step=py-upload -> python wheel 3.1.4 published to PyPI
Sara Venkataraman: pinging docs: I'll open the changelog PR and include the deprecation note for sync client; will mark it as draft until npm done.
deploy-bot: [publish] job=200115 status=running step=ts-upload attempt=1
deploy-bot: [publish] job=200115 status=failed step=ts-upload attempt=1 reason=403 RateLimitExceeded
Diego Morales: re-triggering npm publish with backoff attempt=2
deploy-bot: [publish] job=200115 status=success step=ts-upload attempt=2 -> @redwood/sdk@3.1.4 published under `next`
Hannah Park: good. Run quick smoke: pip install 3.1.4 in staging and npm install @redwood/sdk@3.1.4 in canary. Hold `latest` until 20m stability window. Keep 3.1.2 pinned for rollback anchor.
Sara Venkataraman: changelog PR updated and set to merge once promote happens. Included rollback steps and contact info.
Diego Morales: canary smoke passed at 8m, staging pip install good. No runtime errors.
Hannah Park: promoting now: `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@3.1.4 latest` and update PyPI alias.
deploy-bot: [release] action=promote job=200121 status=success -> @redwood/sdk@3.1.4 set to latest
InfraOps: registry quota issue resolved; will follow up on throttling thresholds to prevent future publishes being rate-limited.
Sara Venkataraman: release-note PR merged and CHANGELOG updated. Also added a short note advising customers who pin `latest` to switch to an explicit patch version if they want to avoid automatic upgrades.
Hannah Park: final summary: Python published first, npm retried with backoff, promoted after smoke, 3.1.2 pinned as rollback for 30m. File follow-up task to add pre-publish registry quota check to CI. Closing thread.
